item.title: Fifth annual Spring on the Ave returns next month | FOX 28 Spokane
item.description: SPOKANE, Wash. -- Spring is here, and so is one of Spokane's favorite annual events. The fifth annual Spring on the Ave is coming to the Sprague Union District on Saturday, April 18 from 10 a.m. until 5 p.m. This free event will feature local businesses, kid-friendly activities, amazing performances, and food and beverage experiences.
